comments.comment: The change deleted the check that stopped the walk at the filesystem root, so a start directory that never reaches root loops forever.
comments.failureScenario: melian-config ./repo src/a.ts calls configFiles("./repo", "repo/src"). dir never equals "./repo": it walks to "repo", then ".", and dirname(".") is ".", so the loop never ends, and with a config.json in the working directory it pushes ./config.json until the heap runs out. The base stopped once the parent equalled the directory.
